comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Still seeing deleted field cf_custom_priority on a workspace board 12 minutes after delete — reopening.

content.text: Still seeing deleted field cf_custom_priority on a workspace board 12 minutes after delete — reopening.

GET /v2/field-metadata continues to list custom fields for up to the full 15-minute cache TTL after an admin deletes them. Clients that cache the response themselves then show pickers for fields that return 404 on write.

Delete handler removes the row from custom_fields but only busts the per-project key fieldmeta:{project_id}. Global and workspace-scoped entries fieldmeta:ws:{id} keep serving the pre-delete snapshot until natural expiry.

Reopened because the first fix busted project keys only; workspace-level metadata used by multi-project boards still served ghosts for the remaining TTL. Expectation is immediate consistency on delete for every cache key that included that field_id.
